name: memory_record
description: Stores one durable fact (decision, invariant, preference, architecture note, or debug finding) optionally attached to a named entity and returns observation_id (or status=exists if identical) in clinical 7-bit ASCII prose so cross-session knowledge is persisted deterministically, preventing duplicate facts, stage directions, or context loss.

content.description: Specifies the self-contained fact statement (1-8000 characters) in clinical 7-bit ASCII prose so historical observations remain unambiguous across sessions, preventing truncated or context-free notes.

entity.description: Specifies the target entity name (service, repo, pattern, concept, operator, or host) matched case-insensitively and created if missing so facts attach to the knowledge graph, preventing orphaned entity references.

entity_type.description: Specifies the canonical entity classification (applied when not 'concept', or omitted to preserve the existing type when 'entity' is specified) so graph nodes retain accurate taxonomy, preventing accidental type downgrades.

summary.description: Specifies a one-line description of the entity (1-2000 characters, replacing the previous summary when 'entity' is specified) so entity recall returns a concise overview, preventing stale or missing entity summaries.

category.description: Specifies the observation classification category so stored facts can be filtered by engineering concern, preventing unstructured observation sprawl.

tags.description: Specifies up to 50 non-empty keyword tags (1-100 characters each) so full-text and tag-filtered searches match related facts, preventing unindexed observations.

confidence.description: Specifies the certainty score between 0.0 and 1.0 (default 1.0) so consumers can weight verified invariants above tentative findings, preventing uncalibrated confidence assumptions.

session_id.description: Specifies a free-form session or task filter label (default 'default', not an isolation boundary) so observations can be scoped by workflow, preventing untraceable session provenance.

attributes.description: Specifies an entity key/value map (up to 4000 serialized characters, merged via RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch where null deletes a key when 'entity' is specified) so structured entity metadata stays current, preventing full-object overwrite loss.
